title: Pakistan to Procure Bulletproof BMW and Mercedes for SCO Summit
excerpt: The government has decided to purchase bulletproof BMW and Mercedes vehicles for the upcoming Shanghai Cooperation Organisation summit.
body_html:
The government has chosen to acquire bulletproof BMW and Mercedes vehicles for the upcoming Shanghai Cooperation Organisation (SCO) summit.

According to the details, authorities decided against using locally manufactured armored vehicles for the high-profile international event.

Instead, the administration opted for the imported armored options to meet the security and protocol requirements for the summit, which is scheduled to take place in 2027.
